After binding, TV rules and the password entry become read-only; local and cloud configurations stay independent. Manage them on your phone.
Local settings uploaded. They are now read-only on the TV.

With remote management on, this TV reports device status, time progress and quiz records to the PlanYourTV cloud for remote management and record viewing on your phone, not for advertising or other purposes. The rules, parent password and AI model key (API Key) stored on this TV are never uploaded; cloud and local configurations stay independent. You can unbind on the phone at any time; reporting stops and the TV keeps its local settings. By continuing, you confirm that you are authorized to manage this TV.
Turn on child mode and auto update?

Turning on child mode also turns on Auto Update, so this TV gets new versions and fixes promptly. New versions download and install automatically while the TV is idle, without interrupting viewing. You can turn Auto Update off at any time in Parent Center.
